summary: Ionis Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting positive clinical data from an open-label extension study of olezarsen in severe hypertriglyceridemia, presented at a medical conference. The filing details longer-term MRI-PDFF results on hepatic fat fraction, safety profile, and patient retention. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is announced. This is a non-material clinical update with no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. There is no impact on stock structure or corporate control; it is a routine operational update under Item 8.01.
